options.text: Because of his association with the modes of material nature
By the will of the demigods

questions.explanation: "The conditioned soul therefore transmigrates into different species of life, higher and lower, because of his association with the modes of material nature." (SB 3.27.3)

questions.question: Although a living entity is transcendental to material existence, why does his material condition not cease?

options.text: Because of his mentality of lording it over material nature

questions.explanation: "Because of his mentality of lording it over material nature, his material existential condition does not cease, and just as in a dream, he is affected by all sorts of disadvantages." (SB 3.27.4)

questions.question: It is the duty of every conditioned soul to engage his polluted consciousness in what?

options.text: Very serious devotional service with detachment

questions.explanation: "It is the duty of every conditioned soul to engage his polluted consciousness, which is now attached to material enjoyment, in very serious devotional service with detachment." (SB 3.27.5)

questions.question: In executing devotional service, how should one see every living entity?

options.text: Equally, without enmity towards anyone yet without intimate connections

questions.explanation: "In executing devotional service, one has to see every living entity equally, without enmity towards anyone yet without intimate connections with anyone." (SB 3.27.7)

questions.question: How should a devotee see his own self upon realizing freedom from false ego?

options.text: Just as he sees the sun in the sky

questions.explanation: "Thus realizing freedom from false ego, one should see his own self just as he sees the sun in the sky." (SB 3.27.10)

questions.question: Though a devotee appears merged in the material elements and senses, he is understood to be awake and freed from what?
questions.explanation: "He is understood to be awake and to be freed from the false ego." (SB 3.27.14)

questions.question: Devahuti inquires: since material nature and the spirit soul are attracted to one another eternally, how is what possible?
questions.explanation: "Since one is attracted to the other eternally, how is their separation possible?" (SB 3.27.17)

questions.question: How can a living entity get liberation, according to Kapila's answer to Devahuti?

options.text: By seriously discharging devotional service unto Me

questions.explanation: "One can get liberation by seriously discharging devotional service unto Me and thereby hearing for a long time about Me or from Me." (SB 3.27.21)

questions.question: The influence of material nature can be removed by serious devotional service, just as what happens to the wooden sticks that cause a fire?

options.text: They are themselves consumed by it

questions.explanation: "This influence can be removed, just as wooden sticks which cause a fire are themselves consumed by it." (SB 3.27.23)

questions.question: By giving up his desire to lord it over material nature, the living entity becomes independent and does what?
questions.explanation: "By therefore giving it up, the living entity becomes independent and stands in his own glory." (SB 3.27.24)

questions.question: Why cannot the influence of material nature harm an enlightened soul, even though he engages in material activities?

options.text: Because he knows the truth of the Absolute, and his mind is fixed on the Supreme Lord
Because he lives in the forest

questions.explanation: "The influence of material nature cannot harm an enlightened soul, even though he engages in material activities, because he knows the truth of the Absolute, and his mind is fixed on the Supreme Personality of Godhead." (SB 3.27.26)

questions.question: After the mystic devotee gives up his present material body and goes to the transcendental abode, what happens?

options.text: He returns after a long time

questions.explanation: "After giving up the present material body, the mystic devotee goes to that transcendental abode and never comes back." (SB 3.27.28-29)

questions.question: When a perfect yogi's attention is no longer attracted to the by-products of mystic powers, what cannot overcome him?
questions.explanation: "His progress towards Me becomes unlimited, and thus the power of death cannot overcome him." (SB 3.27.30)

questions.question: The by-products of mystic powers are described as manifestations of what?
questions.explanation: "The by-products of mystic powers, which are manifestations of the external energy." (SB 3.27.30)

topics.name: Chapter 28: Kapila's Instructions on the Execution of Devotional Service

questions.question: What is the object of the yoga system Kapila explains at the beginning of this chapter?
questions.explanation: "Now I shall explain to you the system of yoga, the object of which is to concentrate the mind." (SB 3.28.1)

questions.question: One should be satisfied with as much gain as one achieves by the grace of the Lord, and one should worship what?

options.text: The lotus feet of a spiritual master

questions.explanation: "One should be satisfied with as much gain as he achieves by the grace of the Lord, and one should worship the lotus feet of a spiritual master." (SB 3.28.2)

questions.question: After withdrawing the senses from sense objects, where should the yogi concentrate the mind?
questions.explanation: "One must observe silence, acquire steadiness by practicing different yogic postures, control the breathing of the vital air, withdraw the senses from sense objects and thus concentrate the mind on the heart." (SB 3.28.5)

questions.question: Fixing the vital air and the mind in one of how many circles of vital air circulation is called samadhi?
questions.explanation: "Fixing the vital air and the mind in one of the six circles of vital air circulation within the body... is called samadhi." (SB 3.28.6)

questions.question: By practicing pranayama, one can eradicate the contamination of what?
questions.explanation: "By practicing the process of pranayama, one can eradicate the contamination of his physiological condition." (SB 3.28.11)

questions.question: By meditating on the Supreme Personality of Godhead, one can become free from what?

options.text: The three modes of material attachment

questions.explanation: "By meditating on the Supreme Personality of Godhead one can become free from the three modes of material attachment." (SB 3.28.11)

questions.question: How is the body of the Supreme Personality of Godhead described in the meditation Kapila teaches?

options.text: Swarthy like the petals of a blue lotus

questions.explanation: "He has... a swarthy body like the petals of a blue lotus." (SB 3.28.13)

questions.question: On His breast the Lord bears which mark?

options.text: The mark of Srivatsa, a curl of white hair

questions.explanation: "On His breast He bears the mark of Srivatsa, a curl of white hair." (SB 3.28.14)

questions.question: What gem is suspended from the Lord's neck?
questions.explanation: "The brilliant Kaustubha gem is suspended from His neck." (SB 3.28.14)

questions.question: The yogi should not take a collective view of all the Lord's limbs, but should do what?

options.text: Fix the mind on each individual limb of the Lord
Concentrate on the Lord's face only
View only the form as a whole

questions.explanation: "The yogi should not take a collective view of all His limbs, but should fix the mind on each individual limb of the Lord." (SB 3.28.20)

questions.question: On which part of the Lord should the devotee first concentrate his mind, adorned with marks of a thunderbolt, goad, banner and lotus?
questions.explanation: "The devotee should first concentrate his mind on the Lord's lotus feet, which are adorned with the marks of a thunderbolt, a goad, a banner and a lotus." (SB 3.28.21)

questions.question: The holy waters of the Ganges, borne on Lord Siva's head, have their source in what?

options.text: The water that washed the Lord's lotus feet

questions.explanation: "Lord Siva becomes all the more blessed by bearing on his head the holy waters of the Ganges, which has its source in the water that washed the Lord's lotus feet." (SB 3.28.22)

questions.question: The Lord's thighs are described as the storehouse of what?
questions.explanation: "The yogi should fix his mind in meditation on the Personality of Godhead's thighs, the storehouse of all energy." (SB 3.28.24)

questions.question: From the Lord's navel, which is the foundation of the entire universe, sprang what?

options.text: The lotus stem containing all the different planetary systems

questions.explanation: "From His navel, which is the foundation of the entire universe, sprang the lotus stem containing all the different planetary systems." (SB 3.28.25)

questions.question: The Lord's chest is described as the source of what?

options.text: All transcendental pleasure for the mind and full satisfaction for the eyes

questions.explanation: "The Lord's chest is the source of all transcendental pleasure for the mind and full satisfaction for the eyes." (SB 3.28.26)

questions.question: The Lord's four arms are the source of what?

options.text: All the powers of the demigods who control material nature

questions.explanation: "The yogi should further meditate upon the Lord's four arms, which are the source of all the powers of the demigods who control the various functions of material nature." (SB 3.28.27)

questions.question: The pearl necklace on the Lord's neck is considered to represent whom?

options.text: The pure living entities who are always engaged in His service

questions.explanation: "The pearl necklace on the Lord's neck, which is considered to represent the pure living entities who are always engaged in His service." (SB 3.28.28)

questions.question: When the mind is completely freed from material contamination and detached, what is it compared to?
questions.explanation: "When the mind is thus completely freed from all material contamination and detached from material objectives, it is just like the flame of a lamp." (SB 3.28.35)

questions.question: The perfectly realized soul discovers that pleasure and pain are actually due to what?

options.text: The false ego, which is a product of ignorance

questions.explanation: "He discovers that pleasure and pain as well as their interactions, which he attributed to his own self, are actually due to the false ego, which is a product of ignorance." (SB 3.28.36)

questions.question: A yogi should see the same soul in all manifestations because all that exists is what?

options.text: A manifestation of different energies of the Supreme

questions.explanation: "A yogi should see the same soul in all manifestations, for all that exists is a manifestation of different energies of the Supreme." (SB 3.28.42)

topics.name: Chapter 29: Explanation of Devotional Service by Lord Kapila

questions.question: Devahuti requests Kapila to explain the path of devotional service, which is described as what?

options.text: The ultimate end of all philosophical systems

questions.explanation: "Now I shall request You to explain the path of devotional service, which is the ultimate end of all philosophical systems." (SB 3.29.1-2)

questions.question: Devahuti asks Kapila to describe eternal time, which is a representation of what?
questions.explanation: "Please also describe eternal time, which is a representation of Your form." (SB 3.29.4)

questions.question: Kapila says there are multifarious paths of devotional service in terms of what?

options.text: The different qualities of the executor

questions.explanation: "There are multifarious paths of devotional service in terms of the different qualities of the executor." (SB 3.29.7)

questions.question: Devotional service executed by a person who is envious, proud, violent and angry, and who is a separatist, is in which mode?
questions.explanation: "Devotional service executed by a person who is envious, proud, violent and angry, and who is a separatist, is considered to be in the mode of darkness." (SB 3.29.8)

questions.question: The worship of Deities in the temple by a separatist, with a motive for material enjoyment, fame and opulence, is devotion in which mode?
questions.explanation: "The worship of Deities in the temple by a separatist, with a motive for material enjoyment, fame and opulence, is devotion in the mode of passion." (SB 3.29.9)

questions.question: When a devotee worships the Lord and offers the results of his activities to free himself from fruitive reactions, his devotion is in which mode?
questions.explanation: "When a devotee worships the Supreme Personality of Godhead and offers the results of his activities in order to free himself from the inebrieties of fruitive activities, his devotion is in the mode of goodness." (SB 3.29.10)

questions.question: Unadulterated devotional ecstasy, uninterrupted by any material condition, is compared to what flowing naturally toward the Supreme Lord?

options.text: The water of the Ganges flowing toward the ocean

questions.explanation: "Just as the water of the Ganges flows naturally down towards the ocean, such devotional ecstasy, uninterrupted by any material condition, flows towards the Supreme Lord." (SB 3.29.11-12)

questions.question: A pure devotee does not accept which kinds of liberation, even though offered by the Lord?

options.text: Salokya, sarsti, samipya, sarupya or ekatva

questions.explanation: "A pure devotee does not accept any kind of liberation — salokya, sarsti, samipya, sarupya or ekatva — even though they are offered by the Supreme Personality of Godhead." (SB 3.29.13)

questions.question: By attaining the highest platform of devotional service, one can overcome what and be situated in the transcendental stage?

options.text: The influence of the three modes of material nature
The need for a spiritual master

questions.explanation: "One can overcome the influence of the three modes of material nature and be situated in the transcendental stage, as is the Lord." (SB 3.29.14)

questions.question: The pure devotee should execute devotional service by giving the greatest respect to whom?

options.text: The spiritual master and the acaryas

questions.explanation: "The pure devotee should execute devotional service by giving the greatest respect to the spiritual master and the acaryas." (SB 3.29.17)

questions.question: Although a devotee is friendly to everyone, whose company should he avoid?

options.text: Persons who are not spiritually advanced

questions.explanation: "Although he is not envious but friendly to everyone, he should avoid the company of persons who are not spiritually advanced." (SB 3.29.18)

questions.question: One who worships the Deity in the temple but neglects the Supersoul present everywhere is described as doing what?
questions.explanation: "If someone neglects or disregards that Supersoul everywhere and engages himself in the worship of the Deity in the temple, that is simply imitation." (SB 3.29.21)

questions.question: One should worship the Deity of the Lord while performing prescribed duties until one realizes what?

options.text: His presence in one's own heart and in the hearts of other living entities

questions.explanation: "One should worship the Deity of the Supreme Personality of Godhead until one realizes My presence in his own heart and in the hearts of other living entities as well." (SB 3.29.25)

questions.question: As what does Kapila say He causes great fear to whoever makes the least discrimination between himself and other living entities?
questions.explanation: "As the blazing fire of death, I cause great fear to whoever makes the least discrimination between himself and other living entities because of a differential outlook." (SB 3.29.26)

questions.question: In Kapila's hierarchy of living beings, who is at the top among human beings divided according to quality and work?

options.text: The intelligent men, designated as brahmanas

questions.explanation: "In that society, the intelligent men, who are designated as brahmanas, are best." (SB 3.29.31)

questions.question: Better than a liberated person, who does Kapila say is best?

options.text: A pure devotee, who executes devotional service without expectation of reward

questions.explanation: "Better than him is a pure devotee, who executes devotional service without expectation of reward." (SB 3.29.32)

questions.question: A perfect devotee offers respect to every living entity because he is convinced that the Lord has entered every body as what?
questions.explanation: "He is under the firm conviction that the Supreme Personality of Godhead has entered the body of every living entity as the Supersoul, or controller." (SB 3.29.34)

questions.question: Anyone who does not know that time is the same Supreme Personality experiences what?
questions.explanation: "Anyone who does not know that time is the same Supreme Personality is afraid of the time factor." (SB 3.29.37)

questions.question: Out of fear of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, the wind blows, the sun shines, and what else happens?
questions.explanation: "Out of fear of the Supreme Personality of Godhead the wind blows, out of fear of Him the sun shines, out of fear of Him the rain pours forth showers." (SB 3.29.40)

questions.question: The eternal time factor, the representative of the Lord, brings about the end of the phenomenal world and dissolves the universe by destroying even whom?
questions.explanation: "It dissolves the universe by destroying even the lord of death, Yamaraja." (SB 3.29.45)

topics.name: Chapter 30: Description by Lord Kapila of Adverse Fruitive Activities

questions.question: Lord Kapila compares a person engaged in material consciousness, who does not know the strength of the time factor carrying him, to what?

options.text: A mass of clouds that does not know the influence of the wind
A blind man in a well

questions.explanation: "As a mass of clouds does not know the powerful influence of the wind, a person engaged in material consciousness does not know the powerful strength of the time factor, by which he is being carried." (SB 3.30.1)

questions.question: Whatever is produced by the materialist with great pain for so-called happiness is destroyed by the Supreme Personality as the time factor, and for this reason the conditioned soul does what?
questions.explanation: "Whatever is produced by the materialist with great pain and labor for so-called happiness, the Supreme Personality, as the time factor, destroys, and for this reason the conditioned soul laments." (SB 3.30.2)

questions.question: What does the misguided materialist fail to understand about his body, home, land and wealth?

options.text: That they are gifts of the Lord
That they are impermanent and temporary
That they are sources of merit
That they belong to the demigods

questions.explanation: "The misguided materialist does not know that his very body is impermanent and that the attractions of home, land and wealth, which are in relationship to that body, are also temporary." (SB 3.30.3)

questions.question: According to Lord Kapila, why is the conditioned living entity satisfied with his own particular species of life, even when in hell?

options.text: Because of the mode of goodness
Because he is deluded by the covering influence of the illusory energy

questions.explanation: "The conditioned living entity is satisfied in his own particular species of life; while deluded by the covering influence of the illusory energy, he feels little inclined to cast off his body, even when in hell, for he takes delight in hellish enjoyment." (SB 3.30.5)

questions.question: Satisfaction with one's standard of living is due to deep-rooted attraction for body, wife, home, children, animals, wealth and what?
questions.explanation: "Such satisfaction with one's standard of living is due to deep-rooted attraction for body, wife, home, children, animals, wealth and friends." (SB 3.30.6)

questions.question: To whom does the attached householder give his heart and senses, becoming falsely charmed?

options.text: A woman who charms him with maya

questions.explanation: "He gives heart and senses to a woman, who falsely charms him with maya." (SB 3.30.8)

questions.question: How does the attached householder use the money he secures by committing violence here and there?

options.text: He gives it all in charity
He himself eats only a little portion and goes to hell for those for whom he earned it
He offers it to the demigods

questions.explanation: "He secures money by committing violence here and there, and although he employs it in the service of his family, he himself eats only a little portion of the food thus purchased, and he goes to hell for those for whom he earned the money in such an irregular way." (SB 3.30.10)

questions.question: When the unsuccessful family man is unable to support them, how do his wife and others treat him?

options.text: They do not treat him with the same respect as before

questions.explanation: "Seeing him unable to support them, his wife and others do not treat him with the same respect as before, even as miserly farmers do not accord the same treatment to their old and worn-out oxen." (SB 3.30.13)

questions.question: How does the foolish family man, maintained by those whom he once maintained, remain at home in old age?

options.text: Like a pet dog, eating whatever is negligently given to him

questions.explanation: "Thus he remains at home just like a pet dog and eats whatever is so negligently given to him." (SB 3.30.15)

questions.question: In the diseased condition described by Kapila, what sound does the dying man produce within his throat upon breathing?
questions.explanation: "He has difficulty breathing, and upon exhaling and inhaling he produces a sound like ghura-ghura, a rattling within the throat." (SB 3.30.16)

questions.question: At the time of death, when he sees the messengers of the lord of death with eyes full of wrath, what does the sinful man do in great fear?
questions.explanation: "At death, he sees the messengers of the lord of death come before him, their eyes full of wrath, and in great fear he passes stool and urine." (SB 3.30.19)

questions.question: What are the messengers who arrest a person engaged in criminal sense gratification called?
questions.explanation: "A person engaged in criminal sense gratification is similarly arrested by the Yamadutas, who bind him by the neck with strong rope and cover his subtle body so that he may undergo severe punishment." (SB 3.30.20)

questions.question: How great a distance does the punished soul have to pass within two or three moments on the way to Yamaraja?
questions.explanation: "Thus he has to pass ninety-nine thousand yojanas within two or three moments, and then he is at once engaged in the torturous punishment which he is destined to suffer." (SB 3.30.24)

questions.question: Into which hells are men and women whose lives were built upon indulgence in illicit sex life put?
questions.explanation: "Men and women whose lives were built upon indulgence in illicit sex life are put into many kinds of miserable conditions in the hells known as Tamisra, Andha-tamisra and Raurava." (SB 3.30.28)

questions.question: What does the man who maintained himself and his family by sinful activities carry with him as passage money when he leaves this world?

options.text: The money he acquired by envying other living entities

questions.explanation: "He goes alone to the darkest regions of hell after quitting the present body, and the money he acquired by envying other living entities is the passage money with which he leaves this world." (SB 3.30.31)

questions.question: A person eager to maintain his family and kinsmen by black methods certainly goes to which darkest region of hell?
questions.explanation: "Therefore a person who is very eager to maintain his family and kinsmen simply by black methods certainly goes to the darkest region of hell, which is known as Andha-tamisra." (SB 3.30.33)

questions.question: After being purged of his sins through hellish conditions and lower animal life, where is one reborn?

options.text: As a human being on this earth

questions.explanation: "Having thus been purged of his sins, one is reborn again as a human being on this earth." (SB 3.30.34)

topics.name: Chapter 31: Lord Kapila's Instructions on the Movements of the Living Entities

questions.question: Under the supervision of the Supreme Lord, through what is the living entity made to enter the womb of a woman to assume a particular type of body?
questions.explanation: "The living entity, the soul, is made to enter into the womb of a woman through the particle of male semen to assume a particular type of body." (SB 3.31.1)

questions.question: According to Lord Kapila, on which night does the mixture of sperm and ovum ferment into a bubble?
questions.explanation: "On the first night, the sperm and ovum mix, and on the fifth night the mixture ferments into a bubble." (SB 3.31.2)

questions.question: In the course of how long is a head formed for the developing embryo?
questions.explanation: "In the course of a month, a head is formed, and at the end of two months the hands, feet and other limbs take shape." (SB 3.31.3)

questions.question: Within how many months from conception do the seven essential ingredients of the body come into existence?
questions.explanation: "Within four months from the date of conception, the seven essential ingredients of the body, namely chyle, blood, flesh, fat, bone, marrow and semen, come into existence." (SB 3.31.4)

questions.question: At the end of how many months do hunger and thirst make themselves felt in the fetus?
questions.explanation: "At the end of five months, hunger and thirst make themselves felt, and at the end of six months, the fetus, enclosed by the amnion, begins to move on the right side of the abdomen." (SB 3.31.4)

questions.question: If the child in the womb is fortunate, what can he remember at that time?

options.text: All the troubles of his past one hundred births

questions.explanation: "At that time, if the child is fortunate, he can remember all the troubles of his past one hundred births, and he grieves wretchedly." (SB 3.31.9)

questions.question: From which month after conception is the child endowed with the development of consciousness?
questions.explanation: "Thus endowed with the development of consciousness from the seventh month after his conception, the child is tossed downward by the airs that press the embryo during the weeks preceding delivery." (SB 3.31.10)

questions.question: The living entity in the frightful womb condition is bound by how many layers of material ingredients?
questions.explanation: "The living entity in this frightful condition of life, bound by seven layers of material ingredients, prays with folded hands, appealing to the Lord, who has put him in that condition." (SB 3.31.11)

questions.question: In his frightful womb condition, what does the living entity do toward the Supreme Personality of Godhead?
questions.explanation: "The living entity in this frightful condition of life, bound by seven layers of material ingredients, prays with folded hands, appealing to the Lord." (SB 3.31.11)

questions.question: To get free from the threefold miseries of conditional life, the conditioned soul must do what unto the Lord only?
questions.explanation: "In order to get free from the threefold miseries of this conditional life, we have to surrender unto Him only." (SB 3.31.16)

questions.question: How old does the soul in the womb say it is when, by the Lord's causeless mercy, it is awakened to consciousness?
questions.explanation: "My dear Lord, by Your causeless mercy I am awakened to consciousness, although I am only ten months old." (SB 3.31.18)

questions.question: Which external energy at once captures the newly born child, beginning the cycle of continual birth and death?
questions.explanation: "Your external energy, called deva-maya, at once captures the newly born child, and immediately false identification, which is the beginning of the cycle of continual birth and death, begins." (SB 3.31.20)

questions.question: By keeping whose lotus feet in his mind does the soul in the womb resolve to be saved from repeated birth and death?
questions.explanation: "Simply by keeping the lotus feet of Lord Visnu in my mind, I shall be saved from entering into the wombs of many mothers for repeated birth and death." (SB 3.31.21)

questions.question: When the newborn child falls on the ground smeared with stool and blood, what does he do under the spell of maya?

options.text: He cries, having lost his superior knowledge

questions.explanation: "He loses his superior knowledge and cries under the spell of maya." (SB 3.31.24)

questions.question: At the sight of his own daughter, in what form did Brahma shamelessly run up to her?
questions.explanation: "At the sight of his own daughter, Brahma was bewildered by her charms and shamelessly ran up to her in the form of a stag when she took the form of a hind." (SB 3.31.36)

questions.question: Among all living entities begotten by Brahma, who alone is immune to the attraction of maya in the form of woman?
questions.explanation: "Amongst all kinds of living entities begotten by Brahma, namely men, demigods and animals, none but the sage Narayana is immune to the attraction of maya in the form of woman." (SB 3.31.37)

questions.question: According to Lord Kapila, what is described in the scripture as the gateway to hell for the advancing devotee?
questions.explanation: "One who aspires to reach the culmination of yoga and has realized his self by rendering service unto Me should never associate with an attractive woman, for such a woman is declared in the scripture to be the gateway to hell for the advancing devotee." (SB 3.31.39)

questions.question: Lord Kapila says a woman, created by the Lord, is the representation of maya, and associating with her is the way of death, compared to what?

options.text: A blind well covered with grass

questions.explanation: "One who associates with such maya by accepting services must certainly know that this is the way of death, just like a blind well covered with grass." (SB 3.31.40)

topics.name: Chapter 32: Entanglement in Fruitive Activities

questions.question: The person who lives in the center of household life derives material benefits by performing religious rituals, fulfilling his desire for economic development and what?
questions.explanation: "The person who lives in the center of household life derives material benefits by performing religious rituals, and thereby he fulfills his desire for economic development and sense gratification." (SB 3.32.1)

questions.question: To which planet can materialistic persons devoted to the forefathers and demigods be elevated, where they drink an extract of the soma plant?
questions.explanation: "Such materialistic persons, attracted by sense gratification and devoted to the forefathers and demigods, can be elevated to the moon, where they drink an extract of the soma plant." (SB 3.32.3)

questions.question: All the planets of materialistic persons, including the heavenly planets, are vanquished when the Supreme Lord Hari goes to His bed of serpents, known as what?
questions.explanation: "All the planets of the materialistic persons, including all the heavenly planets, such as the moon, are vanquished when the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Hari, goes to His bed of serpents, which is known as Ananta Sesa." (SB 3.32.4)

questions.question: Those who are intelligent and of purified consciousness are completely satisfied in what?
questions.explanation: "Those who are intelligent and are of purified consciousness are completely satisfied in Krsna consciousness." (SB 3.32.5)

questions.question: By executing one's occupational duties with detachment and without false egoism, what can one easily enter into?
questions.explanation: "By thus executing so-called material duties he can easily enter into the kingdom of God." (SB 3.32.6)

questions.question: Worshipers of the Hiranyagarbha expansion of the Personality of Godhead remain within the material world until the end of two of what, when Lord Brahma also dies?
questions.explanation: "Worshipers of the Hiranyagarbha expansion of the Personality of Godhead remain within this material world until the end of two pararddhas, when Lord Brahma also dies." (SB 3.32.8)

questions.question: Yogis who give up their bodies after reaching the planet of Brahma enter into whose body and can then enter the kingdom of God when he is liberated?
questions.explanation: "After giving up their bodies, they enter into the body of Lord Brahma, and therefore when Brahma is liberated and goes to the Supreme Personality of Godhead, who is the Supreme Brahman, such yogis can also enter into the kingdom of God." (SB 3.32.10)

questions.question: Lord Kapila advises his mother to take direct shelter, by devotional service, of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, who is seated where?
questions.explanation: "By devotional service take direct shelter of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, who is seated in everyone's heart." (SB 3.32.11)

questions.question: To what are persons who give up hearing of the Lord and indulge in hearing abominable materialistic activities compared?
questions.explanation: "Because they are averse to the nectar of the activities of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, they are compared to stool-eating hogs." (SB 3.32.19)

questions.question: By which course of the sun are materialistic persons allowed to go to the planet called Pitriloka?
questions.explanation: "Such materialistic persons are allowed to go to the planet called Pitrloka by the southern course of the sun, but they again come back to this planet." (SB 3.32.20)

questions.question: When the results of their pious activities are exhausted, what happens to those raised to a high position?

options.text: They fall down and come back to this planet

questions.explanation: "When the results of their pious activities are exhausted, they fall down by higher arrangement and again come back to this planet, just as any person raised to a high position sometimes all of a sudden falls." (SB 3.32.21)

questions.question: The Supreme Personality of Godhead alone is complete transcendental knowledge, but according to different processes of understanding He appears as impersonal Brahman, as Paramatma, as the Supreme Personality of Godhead, or as what?
questions.explanation: "He appears differently, either as impersonal Brahman, as Paramatma, as the Supreme Personality of Godhead or as the purusa-avatara." (SB 3.32.26)

questions.question: What is the greatest common understanding for all yogis, achievable by different kinds of yoga?
questions.explanation: "The greatest common understanding for all yogis is complete detachment from matter, which can be achieved by different kinds of yoga." (SB 3.32.27)

questions.question: Philosophical research culminates in understanding whom?
questions.explanation: "Philosophical research culminates in understanding the Supreme Personality of Godhead." (SB 3.32.32)

questions.question: Lord Kapila says he has explained the process of devotional service and its identity in how many social divisions?
questions.explanation: "I have explained to you the process of devotional service and its identity in four different social divisions." (SB 3.32.37)

questions.question: For whom is this confidential instruction NOT meant?

options.text: The envious, agnostics, and those unclean in behavior
Those respectful to the spiritual master
Those friendly to all living entities

questions.explanation: "This instruction is not meant for the envious, for the agnostics or for persons who are unclean in their behavior." (SB 3.32.39)

questions.question: According to Lord Kapila, what is the result for anyone who once meditates upon Him with faith and affection and hears and chants about Him?

options.text: He surely goes back home, back to Godhead

questions.explanation: "Anyone who once meditates upon Me with faith and affection, who hears and chants about Me, surely goes back home, back to Godhead." (SB 3.32.43)

topics.name: Chapter 33: Activities of Kapila

questions.question: Devahuti is described as the mother of Lord Kapila and the wife of whom?
questions.explanation: "Thus Devahuti, the mother of Lord Kapila and wife of Kardama Muni, became freed from all ignorance concerning devotional service and transcendental knowledge." (SB 3.33.1)

questions.question: Lord Kapila is called the author of the basic principles of which system of philosophy, described as the background of liberation?
questions.explanation: "She offered her obeisances unto the Lord, the author of the basic principles of the Sankhya system of philosophy, which is the background of liberation." (SB 3.33.1)

questions.question: According to Devahuti's prayer, why is Brahma said to be unborn?

options.text: Because he takes birth from the lotus flower growing from the Lord's abdomen
Because he meditated for a million years

questions.explanation: "Brahma is said to be unborn because he takes birth from the lotus flower which grows from Your abdomen while You lie in the ocean at the bottom of the universe." (SB 3.33.2)

questions.question: Devahuti marvels that at the end of the millennium the Lord lies down on a leaf of what tree, licking the toe of His lotus foot like a baby?
questions.explanation: "At the end of the millennium You lie down on a leaf of a banyan tree, and just like a small baby, You lick the toe of Your lotus foot." (SB 3.33.4)

questions.question: According to Devahuti, even a person born in a family of dog-eaters becomes eligible to perform Vedic sacrifices if he once does what?

options.text: Utters the holy name of the Supreme Personality of Godhead

questions.explanation: "Even a person born in a family of dog-eaters immediately becomes eligible to perform Vedic sacrifices if he once utters the holy name of the Supreme Personality of Godhead." (SB 3.33.6)

questions.question: Devahuti declares that the Lord is Lord Visnu Himself under the name of Kapila, and at the time of dissolution all of what are sustained in Him only?
questions.explanation: "At the time of dissolution, all the Vedas are sustained in You only." (SB 3.33.8)

questions.question: Lord Kapila tells his mother that by following the path of self-realization He instructed, she shall be liberated when?
questions.explanation: "You can execute this system without difficulty, and by following it you shall very soon be liberated, even within your present body." (SB 3.33.10)

questions.question: After instructing his beloved mother and taking permission from her, what did Lord Kapila do?

options.text: He left His home, His mission having been fulfilled

questions.explanation: "The Supreme Personality of Godhead Kapila, after instructing His beloved mother, took permission from her and left His home, His mission having been fulfilled." (SB 3.33.12)

questions.question: In whose house, decorated with flowers as the flower crown of the river Sarasvati, did Devahuti practice samadhi?
questions.explanation: "She practiced samadhi in the house of Kardama Muni, which was so beautifully decorated with flowers that it was considered the flower crown of the river Sarasvati." (SB 3.33.13)

questions.question: The opulence of the household of Kardama Muni was sometimes envied by whom?

options.text: Those who travel in outer space in airplanes

questions.explanation: "His opulence was sometimes envied by those who travel in outer space in airplanes." (SB 3.33.15)

questions.question: When Devahuti would enter the lovely garden to bathe in the lotus pond, who would sing about Kardama's glorious household life?
questions.explanation: "The associates of the denizens of heaven, the Gandharvas, would sing about Kardama's glorious household life." (SB 3.33.19)

questions.question: Despite all her possessions envied even by the ladies of heaven, what was Devahuti only sorry about?

options.text: That her great son was separated from her

questions.explanation: "She was only sorry that her great son was separated from her." (SB 3.33.20)

questions.question: Devahuti's grief at the loss of her son Kapila is compared to what?

options.text: A cow affected when her calf dies

questions.explanation: "She was very aggrieved at the loss of her son, just as a cow is affected when her calf dies." (SB 3.33.21)

questions.question: By following the principles instructed by Kapila, Devahuti soon became liberated and achieved the Supreme Personality of Godhead in which aspect?
questions.explanation: "Devahuti soon became liberated from material bondage and achieved the Supreme Personality of Godhead, as Supersoul, without difficulty." (SB 3.33.30)

questions.question: The most sacred spot where Devahuti achieved her perfection is known all over the three worlds by what name?
questions.explanation: "It is known all over the three worlds as Siddhapada." (SB 3.33.31)

questions.question: After leaving His father's hermitage with His mother's permission, in which direction did the great sage Kapila go?
questions.explanation: "The great sage Kapila, the Personality of Godhead, left His father's hermitage with the permission of His mother and went towards the northeast." (SB 3.33.33)

questions.question: When Kapila passed in the northern direction, who offered Him oblations and a place of residence?
questions.explanation: "The ocean offered Him oblations and a place of residence." (SB 3.33.34)

questions.question: Anyone who hears or reads the narration of Kapiladeva and His mother becomes a devotee of the Lord, who is carried by whom?
questions.explanation: "Anyone who hears or reads this narration becomes a devotee of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, who is carried by Garuda." (SB 3.33.37)
